fixtures.name: spur_retune_sequence
fixtures.layout: float32 LE x 4096 per frame; float 0 = step word; usable bin j = float j+1; linear power (not dBm)
fixtures.source: three recorded SignalSDR Pro frames (tools/tezuka_mcp/tests/fixtures, 2026-11-08T18:01Z, 1.09 GHz, 2.5 MHz, Average x1023, gain 30 dB Manual), cycled; retuned through the events file (see `events`)
fixtures.condition: cold start at 1.09 GHz, then retuned by > span at 60 s (1.095 GHz), 120 s (1.1 GHz) and 180 s (back to 1.09 GHz) through scripted state/rx/frequency events; the same recorded frames throughout
fixtures.expected_basis: nothing is on air but the receiver's own DC spur: any accepted label is a false accept. Each retune relearns the background and the bins hot at a second frequency become receiver spurs, so masked_bins can only grow (the coverage series records how much of the span is left to classify)

events.contents:
# spur_retune_sequence: the LO moves by more than the 2.5 MHz span at each step,
# so a bin hot at two of these frequencies is counted as a receiver spur
0 state/rx/frequency 1090000000
60 state/rx/frequency 1095000000
120 state/rx/frequency 1100000000
180 state/rx/frequency 1090000000
events.format: one event per line: <t_seconds> <topic> <payload>; '#' comments; sorted by t; passed to the daemon as -E
